notFoundBack: Wrong turn. Back to the trailhead
recipeMetaDescription: Simon Adrell, senior backend developer in Örebro since 2012: .NET, C#, Azure and agentic development, served as a recipe card.
recipeWordmarkLabel: Code By Simon, top of the recipe
recipeIntro: One senior backend developer, homemade in Örebro since 2012, now cooked with AI agents. Mixed 1 : 0.8, tested on long trail runs.
photoAlt: Hands on a keyboard at Simon's desk
ingAgents: Claude Code, MCP, Azure AI Foundry
step1: Start in 2012 with a solid base of C#.
step2: Fold in React Native, Svelte and DevOps. Taste as you go.
step3: Reduce to .NET, C# and Azure until rich and stable.
step4: Certify on Azure in 2024, then on Azure AI and agentic AI in 2026.
step5: Let it rest on a long trail run. The best ideas show up around km 30.
step6: Hand the typing to agents. Add checks so they can't cut corners, and keep steering.
step7: Serve warm, from Örebro, in English or Swedish.
methodTip: Works best with a clear problem and a team that likes to ship.
stoveIntro: Agentic development isn't only building agents. It's how I build everything now: Claude Code agents do the typing, machine checks keep them honest, and I steer.
howGuardrailsText: KickIt, a live futsal tournament platform on Azure, is my lab: coding agents work inside a versioned AGENTS.md, pre-flight checks, PR routines and a lessons log. Hooks lint and type-check after every edit, and a reviewer agent reads every diff.
howParallelText: Ready stories build side by side, one agent session and git worktree each. When a pull request merges, the next story starts.
howCompoundText: When I have to correct an agent, the fix becomes a lint rule, test or hook, so it never makes that mistake twice.
agentLampverketText: Runs the lights at home through Home Assistant's MCP server. .NET 10 and Model Context Protocol.
agentTriageText: Multi-agent triage of incoming cases for Swedish public sector. Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, MCP and .NET.
agentReScanText: Technical supervisor for a student team's AI recycling app: image recognition and GPT-4o on Azure AI Foundry, from concept to a working app.
agentProblemSolverText: An AI idea app on Azure Container Apps, built for a real public launch.
servedSt1Text: Project lead for a new Next.js and DatoCMS site: 132 pull requests in five weeks. I set up how Claude Code built it, one story per agent, machine checks as the gate and people deciding.
servedTolkText: Leading the technical evaluation of AI speech-to-speech interpreting for healthcare, tested in Arabic and Somali, in the lab and in the field.
servedSpsmText: A C#/.NET web API that encrypts stored forms, so they don't risk becoming public documents.
served365Text: Got the backend ready for the app and SDK launch: new microservices and a business-critical invoicing service on C#, Entity Framework and Azure Service Bus.
servedJetshopText: Integrated Vipps payments and Ingrid delivery, moved messaging from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus with MassTransit, and built test environments with Terraform.
servedBilvisionText: Developer, DevOps and team lead on B2B vehicle data. Helped grow the team from 3 to 17 people, and ran the BI on SSAS, SSIS and SSRS.
notesGel: The real recipe is maltodextrin and fructose, 1 : 0.8, in a reusable flask. About 45 kr less per gel than shop bought, and it powers my long runs on the trails around Örebro.
notesNext: Next big test: Kullamannen Sprint Ultra, 108 km, in 2027. Favourite city: Porto. Favourite hikes: Picos de Europa and the Massif Central.
orderLine: Orders by email or LinkedIn. Freshly made in Örebro.
footerLine: Written in Örebro, between two runs.
